scopeLabel: Source-scoped direct PbSe inks, selenium-precursor preparation, conventional comparison route, PbS and ZnO adjuncts, device fabrication, and distinct characterization and cost-estimation contexts. All seven main and seventeen SI pages were read as text and images. Unreported conditions and physical batch joins remain unknown; source conflicts remain explicit. This is not a complete laboratory SOP or a full-paper narrative Reader.

availability.morphology_illustration: Measured source figures and reported specimen facts are retained. No finite particle, device cross-section or atomic arrangement is reconstructed from incomplete geometry or unknown physical batch identity. Optional bulk PbSe reference selection is restricted to the named XRD contexts.

bindings.caption: Retain the source materials-cost calculation. Cost-estimation context for 1 g PbSe solid/ink as stated. These tabulated amounts must not fill missing experimental recipe charges. Heating and laboratory costs are excluded from the conventional estimate; historical currency values are not current prices. Qualified action illustration; no unreported vessel dimensions, hardware, measured molecular geometry, or experimental trace is implied.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
